title: Single-cell concurrent increments serialise per instance and return witness of prior write
asA: developer whose Worker needs an authoritative counter, session store or lock behind a swappable boundary
iWant: one SingleCellObject class instance to observe concurrent increments in per-instance FIFO order and return the sum plus a written witness
soThat: two concurrent callers cannot silently overwrite each other and a domain assertion can prove the write happened before the read

acceptanceCriteria.description: Two concurrent increment(delta=1) invocations against a named SingleCellObject with an initial counter of 0 resolve to {counter, witness} pairs whose counter values are 1 and 2 (in some order) and whose witness values are 0 and 1. The final read() returns counter 2. No non-serialised interleaving is possible: the counter is always equal to the sum of the deltas at read-time.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a SingleCellObject wired with an in-memory DO storage driver at counter 0
acceptanceCriteria.when: two increment(1) invocations fire concurrently and a read follows
acceptanceCriteria.then: the two increments resolve with counters {1, 2} in FIFO order, witnesses {0, 1}, and the final read returns 2
